newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Allegiance started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Allegiance started as hold.

text.p: --Chicago Corp analyst Robert Junkin said he started coverage of Allegiance Corp with a hold rating.
--Shares in Allegiance, the Baxter International spin-off that started trading today, were unchanged at 18.
--"We believe that Allegiance has excellent long-term prospects, however, we would advise investors to seek a lower entry point," Junkin said.
--Allegiance is comprised chiefly of a hospital supply and cost management business that Baxter acquired some years ago, but this year decided to shed.
